Okay, I've been playing this one a lot lately :D. Mechanically, the actual training is kinda weak -- have her work until you can afford a class, send her to a class, then have her work some more. However, the strength of this game is the art and quests. The art is professional level quality, and looks like disney characters (with a few more shaders). The quests are interesting and well written, and offer the meat of the gameplay through your choices during said quests.

Also, to run in linux -- download the game, drill down into the directories until you are in the "autorun" directory, and run renpy on the "game" directory. In fact, I moved the game directory up to the top, and removed everything that wasn't in that directory.
